color.note: Two modes (data-theme) and six accent palettes (data-accent: indigo default, emerald, rose, amber, cyan, violet). Components only ever use the role tokens (accent, accent-h, accent-faint, accent-fi, accent-soft, halo, purple, accent-ink, btn-from, on-accent); the palette tokens exist so data-accent can re-point them.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the content wash and the login hero. Never put text straight on it without a card unless it is ink, ink2 or ink3.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid surfaces: sidebar, topbar, drawer, popover, inputs, quick-action cards, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Table header row, code blocks, dropzone, readonly inputs, mapping canvas.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Nav icon pills, neutral badges, switch track (off), progress tracks, hover on segmented buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and identifiers, on bg, surface, raised, glass and every *-bg tint.

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Body and secondary text, form labels, table cells, on bg, surface, raised and glass.

tokens.name: ink3
tokens.usage: Meta text: section labels, table headers, timestamps, help text, placeholders, chart labels, nav items at rest. On bg, surface, raised and glass (4.6:1 or more in both themes). Corrected from the prototype's #6b7394 / #5c6180, which missed 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink4
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative strokes (pipeline arrows, upload icon). Never readable text, placeholders included: 2.4:1 light, 1.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: bdr
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card dividers, table rows, input borders, drawer edges.

tokens.name: bdr-s
tokens.usage: Strong border: hover on buttons and inputs, topbar bottom edge in dark, mapping connectors.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted card fill for tiles, panels and cards, always with a blur(glass-blur) backdrop and a glass-b border.

tokens.name: glass-b
tokens.usage: Border of glass cards, command search and env badge.

tokens.name: switch-knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob, on and off, in both modes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind an open drawer.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success: Active, Healthy, Processing; dots, icons, bars and numerals 24px+. For small text use ok-t.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok-t text (badges, callouts, pipeline target chip).

tokens.name: ok-t
tokens.usage: Success text under 24px: badge labels, deltas, 'Healthy', decision-table outputs, schema strings. On ok-bg, surface and glass.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning: Draft, Pending, Slow, the In Queue tile; dots, icons, bars and numerals 24px+. For small text use warn-t.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn-t text.

tokens.name: warn-t
tokens.usage: Warning text under 24px. On warn-bg, surface and glass.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Error: Error, Down, Retry, Failures; dots, icons, bars and numerals.

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind err-t text; danger nav count.

tokens.name: err-t
tokens.usage: Error text under 24px: error codes, Escalate, 'Down'. On err-bg, surface and glass.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational: user and system events in the timeline, the info quick action.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind info icons and info-t text.

tokens.name: info-t
tokens.usage: Informational text under 24px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The active theme colour: active nav pill, focus borders, chart line, selected states, progress fills. Re-pointed by data-accent on <html>. As text use accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-h
tokens.usage: Deeper accent: end of the primary-button gradient; the light-mode accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-faint
tokens.usage: Tint behind active nav items, tags, the active segment and accent icon chips.

tokens.name: accent-fi
tokens.usage: Text on accent-faint: tags and the active segment.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Hover wash on nav items and table rows; the 3px input focus glow.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Coloured glow under the primary button, active nav pill, logo mark and avatar.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: partner of accent in gradients (logo, avatar, tile strip, progress bar) and the Transform pipeline stage. Teal in Emerald, pink in Rose, orange in Amber, sky in Cyan.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used as text and small icons: links, active nav label, 'Auto-refresh: ON', condition cells, schema keys. On surface, glass and accent-faint in both themes.

tokens.name: btn-from
tokens.usage: Start colour of the primary-button gradient (accent-h for Emerald, Amber and Cyan in light so on-accent text passes).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any accent fill: primary button, active nav pill, avatar initials, selected mode button, logo glyph. White in light, near-black in dark (light accents fail with white).
